fractionation method: SDS-PAGE, mixed mode reversed phase-anion exchange (MM RP-AX) HPLC

The SDS-PAGE fractionation approach (Fig. 1) resulted in the identification of 18,955 peptide sequences. The two samples were then fractionated using mixed mode reversed phase-anion exchange (MM RP-AX) HPLC as described by Phillips et al..
